name: Suedkorea: Frau verliert 70 Mio. Won an Deepfake-'Elon-Musk'-Romance-Scam
name_de: Suedkorea: Frau verliert 70 Mio. Won an Deepfake-'Elon-Musk'-Romance-Scam
name_en: South Korea: woman loses 70 million won to deepfake 'Elon Musk' romance scam
description: Eine suedkoreanische Frau (Pseudonym Jeong Ji-sun) verlor rund 70 Mio. Won (ca. 50.770 USD) an einen Romance-Scam mit Deepfake-Video eines vorgeblichen 'Elon Musk'. Der Kontakt begann am 17. Juli 2023 ueber Instagram; nach einem Deepfake-Videoanruf glaubte sie an Echtheit und ueberwies Geld zur angeblichen Investition. Der Fall wurde in der KBS-Sendung 'In-Depth 60 Minutes' am 19. April 2024 öffentlich.

description_en: A South Korean woman (pseudonym Jeong Ji-sun) lost roughly 70 million won (about $50,770) to a romance scam featuring a deepfake video of a supposed 'Elon Musk'. Contact began on 17 July 2023 via Instagram; after a deepfake video call she believed it genuine and transferred money for purported investments. The case became public on KBS programme 'In-Depth 60 Minutes' on 19 April 2024.
